title: Cold tasting panel: sample handling
titleZh: 試飲小組：冷飲樣品操作
passage:
Rill Foods | Cold drink tasting panel
The tasting team compares three drinks without seeing the brand names. Use only the two-letter codes printed on the cup stickers when recording scores. The product names remain in a sealed envelope until every panel member has finished scoring.
If a sticker comes off, do not try to identify the drink by colour or smell. Give the cup to the preparation desk and ask for a fresh sample. The desk uses the tray map to prepare a new coded cup. Keep your score sheet at your seat while waiting.
An orange dot on a sticker means the drink contains soy. Panel members avoiding soy should skip that sample but can score the others. Mark “not tasted” for any skipped cup; do not enter a numeric score.
passageZh:
溪谷食品｜冷飲試飲小組
試飲小組在看不到品牌名稱的情況下比較三款飲料。記錄分數時，只用杯子貼紙上的兩個英文字母代碼。所有成員都完成評分前，品名表留在封好的信封裡。
如果杯子貼紙脫落，請勿靠顏色或氣味辨認飲料。把杯子交回備料台，要求換一杯。工作人員會依托盤配置圖準備一杯另一杯貼有代碼的同款樣品。等候期間請把評分表留在自己的座位。
貼紙上的橘色圓點表示飲料含大豆。需要避免大豆的成員應跳過該樣品，但可照常評其他飲料。跳過的杯子請標示「未試飲」，不要填數字分數。
